plan.objective: Ultimate AI Intelligence: Human-Indistinguishable Review Responses

context.current_state: - ai_engine.py has a 2-pass pipeline (Generate + Audit). No temperature control, no signal extraction, no burstiness engineering. - call_llm() hardcodes temperature=0.7 for ALL passes. - STAR_INSTRUCTIONS are shallow strings with no psychological architecture. - No Signal Extraction pass (Pass 0) exists. - No Variance Engine exists (opener_type, structure_tag not in DB). - TWENTY_FOUR_PATTERNS exist but do not include the new Layer 3 / Layer 5 patterns.
context.target_state: - A 4-Pass pipeline: Signal Extraction → Weighted Generation → Burstiness Humaniser → Cognitive Audit. - Per-pass temperature matrix (0.6 to 0.9) based on star_rating and pass number. - Structural Variance Engine: DB tracks last 5 opener_types and structure_tags per user to force rotation. - Amygdala Scan hard-wired into Pass 3 for 1-2 star reviews. - Advanced Persona Injection (small business owner, not corporate manager). - Register Library (Restaurants, Salons, Medical, Gyms, etc.) for tonal permissions. - 3 few-shot examples (varied tone, length, structure) in Pass 1. - Subjectivity Injection mandatory in Pass 2. - Quality Score (1-24) computed in Pass 3 and stored on the reply record.

wave.name: Database Foundation
wave.description: Add variance tracking columns to replies and business_register to users. This is the foundation the Variance Engine depends on.
wave.task: Add to public.replies: - opener_type TEXT (e.g. 'name', 'experience', 'item', 'reaction', 'question') - structure_tag TEXT (e.g. 'A', 'B', 'C', 'D') - quality_score SMALLINT (0-24, computed by Pass 3) Add to public.users: - business_register TEXT DEFAULT 'restaurant' (allowed values: restaurant, salon, gym, medical, automotive, hotel)

wave.name: AI Engine Core Overhaul
wave.description: The complete re-architecture of ai_engine.py into a 4-pass pipeline.
wave.task: Add temperature parameter to call_llm(). For Gemini native calls: pass temperature via config dict. For OpenAI/OpenRouter calls: pass temperature in create() call. Default = 0.75. Each pass will pass its own temperature value.

REPLACE STAR_INSTRUCTIONS with STAR_CONTRACTS dict containing: - approach (string) - emotional_contract (string explaining WHY) - required_elements (list) - forbidden (list) - temperature (float: 0.6-0.9) - word_target (tuple: min, max)
ADD REGISTER_LIBRARY dict for 6 business types: - restaurant, salon, gym, medical, automotive, hotel - Each has: permission_level, forbidden_phrases, ideal_tone, sample_voice
ADD OPENER_TYPES list ['name','experience','item','reaction','question'] ADD STRUCTURE_TAGS list ['A','B','C','D'] with template strings
EXTEND TWENTY_FOUR_PATTERNS with 5 new patterns from the Intelligence doc: 25. Symmetry openers (using the same word 3+ times) 26. Topic Echo (repeating reviewer's exact phrase verbatim) 27. "Ensuring" passive (we will ensure vs we will) 28. Platform clichés (hope this review helps) 29. Hollow superlatives in closers (best regards ever)

ADD extract_review_signals(review_text, reviewer_name) -> dict Implements: - specific_items: regex extraction of quoted nouns and food/service items - staff_names: capitalised proper nouns after role-indicator words - occasion: keyword matching (birthday, anniversary, first visit, regular, special) - emotional_register: detection of formality (lowercase/emoji = casual; full sentences = formal) - word_count: len(text.split()) - has_complaint: any negative sentiment word detected - review_formality: 'casual' | 'formal' Returns context_dict used to inject into Pass 1 prompt.

ADD get_variance_context(user_id) -> dict Queries supabase for last 5 replies for this user_id. Returns: - recent_openers: list of last 5 opener_type values - recent_structures: list of last 5 structure_tag values - suggested_opener: first opener_type NOT in recent_openers (or least used) - suggested_structure: first structure_tag NOT in recent_structures
ADD get_word_target(star_rating, variance_context) -> tuple[int, int] Rotates through Short/Medium/Long bands per the variance engine rules.

EXTEND generate_reply() signature to accept: - reviewer_name: str = "" - user_id: str = "" (for variance engine lookup) - business_register: str = "restaurant" (from user profile)
CHANGE internal flow to 4 passes: Pass 0: extract_review_signals() + get_variance_context() Pass 1: Weighted Generation (temperature from star contract) Pass 2: Burstiness Humaniser (temperature 0.75) Pass 3: Cognitive Audit (temperature 0.5)
CHANGE return dict to include: - text, tokens, cost_usd, model_used (existing) - opener_type (from Pass 3 response parsing) - structure_tag (from Pass 3 response parsing) - quality_score (from Pass 3 scoring matrix)

BUILD new Pass 1 system prompt using: - Advanced Persona ("You are the owner of {business_name}...") - REGISTER_LIBRARY voice for this business_register - Context injection from Pass 0 signals - STAR_CONTRACTS[star_rating] full instruction block - Variance context injection ("Do NOT use opener type X, recent structures were A,C,A") - 3 few-shot examples (hardcoded, varied by star: 5-star casual, 4-star professional, 2-star empathetic) - Burstiness requirement (min 1 sentence under 8 words, min 1 over 18 words) - Word target from variance engine - Security delimiter between review text and prompt

BUILD new Pass 2 Burstiness Humaniser prompt: - Structural fixes (rhythm, opener, closer) - Word-level fixes (full banned word list) - Subjectivity Injection (mandatory 1 new subjectivity marker) - Strategic Imperfection (1 deliberate human irregularity) - Emotional Temperature Check - OUTPUT: revised reply ONLY

BUILD new Pass 3 Cognitive Audit prompt: - Specificity Test - Opener Test (no "Thank you" or name as first word) - Closer Test (no generic closers) - Rhythm Test (metronome check) - Amygdala Scan (for star_rating ≤ 2): ban defensive first-sentence words - AI Vocabulary Final Check - Cross-Review Uniformity Flag - Quality Score matrix (8 dimensions, 1-3 each = max 24) - OUTPUT FORMAT: reply text + JSON metadata block: {"opener_type": "...", "structure_tag": "...", "quality_score": N, "changes": "..."}

wave.name: Route Integration
wave.description: Update the replies route to pass new parameters and persist new fields.
wave.task: In the generate endpoint: - Extract reviewer_name from request body (already in reviews table, pass through) - Extract user_id from JWT - Fetch business_register from users table - Pass all 3 new params to generate_reply() - Persist opener_type, structure_tag, quality_score to the replies record on INSERT

wave.name: Verification
wave.description: Manual smoke test of the new pipeline.
wave.task:
Test Case A: 5-star restaurant review ("Best biryani in town!") - Expected: Warm, short (40-65 words), item-specific, no "Thank you" opener - Check quality_score >= 18
Test Case B: 1-star review with complaint ("Waited 40 minutes, food was cold") - Expected: Empathy-first first sentence, zero defensive words, offline path included - Check Amygdala words absent from sentence 1
Test Case C: 4-star salon review mentioning "Sophie" - Expected: Sophie mentioned naturally, service acknowledged, gap mentioned honestly - Check business_register='salon' voice applied
Test Case D: 3-star mixed review - Expected: Both sides held, no tipping to positive or negative - Check both positive and negative acknowledgment present
Generate 3 sequential replies for same user. Verify opener_type rotates (not same value 3x in a row). Verify structure_tag rotates.
